title: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
description: Yogurt-marinated chicken charred under high heat, then simmered in a butter-and-cashew tomato sauce until it turns rich, orange, and impossible to stop eating with naan.

image.alt: Butter chicken curry with mint garnish, served with rice

ingredients: 700g boneless chicken thighs, cut into large chunks
steps: Whisk the yogurt, lemon juice, cumin, half the chili powder, and half the garam masala together. Toss with the chicken and marinate at least 30 minutes (overnight improves it).
Sear the marinated chicken in a very hot, lightly oiled pan or under a broiler, 3–4 minutes per side, until charred in spots but not cooked through. Set aside.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a pot over medium heat. Cook the onion 6–7 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic and ginger, cooking 1 minute, then add the crushed tomatoes, cashews, remaining chili powder, and water. Simmer 15 minutes.
Blend the sauce until completely smooth, then return it to the pot.
Stir in the seared chicken and simmer 8–10 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in the cream, remaining garam masala, sugar, and remaining 2 tbsp butter. Season with salt and simmer 2 minutes. Finish with cilantro.
note: Char the chicken hard before it goes into the sauce — that browning is the difference between butter chicken and plain tomato-creamed chicken.
